notes: The TV catches up with the site. AI takes New’s place in the side rail: describe a mood and get picks with a line on why. A film’s page has its poster, genre chips and a tidier row of buttons. Sources read in plain words (BluRay · DD+ · H.265) — pressing a row saves it, Stream is the smaller button beside Save, and your own copy is the green row at the top. A slimmer player with intro and credits marks on the bar and smaller popups. Continue Watching shows the frame you stopped on with what is left. RIGHT on the last billboard button turns the slide, LEFT on the first turns it back, UP opens the side rail.
